extra.leak_mechanism: pa-core/src/session_engine/tool_bridge.rs ToolDefinitionBridge::execute spawns per tool call: loop { if signal.is_aborted() { abort.cancel(); break } sleep(10ms) }. pa-agent run_with_lifecycle never aborts the run signal on normal completion, so every normally-completed tool call leaves a permanent 10ms polling task in the worker. Measured at N=1 completed tool call: worker tokio thread 104.4-104.6/s constant for the full 45min horizon (and 106.4-106.5/s in the 600s windows). The leak scales structurally with completed tool calls (one spawned loop per call); N>1 scaling not re-measured after the first measurement VM hit max runtime (leak-curve slots lost, both ok=False - disclosed).
